name: Spirits Walking The Earth
overview: Scripture reveals that the dead do not return to walk the earth, as Job 7:9 affirms that those who go down to the grave do not come up again. Isaiah 26:19, however, promises a future resurrection when the dead will rise, indicating that life after death is a divine act rather than a present reality. The unsettling image of unclean spirits wandering, as described in Luke 11:24, contrasts with the assurance that God alone controls life and death. The tearing of the temple veil at Christ's crucifixion (Matthew 27:51) symbolizes the breaking of barriers between God and man, pointing to Christ's victory over death and the hope of resurrection.
